system.description:
Choose a target within Very Far range.
You can see through their eyes and
hear through their ears through a
hacked sensory feed, neural bridge,
surveillance implant, or signal parasite.
You can transition between using your
own senses or the target’s freely until
you run another protocol or until your
next rest.
